description: We are Savanna Orbit, creators of Kaka-to-Bazara (www.kakatobazara.earth)—a live app using NASA satellite data and AI to help Nigerian farmers unlock post-harvest soil moisture. We bring skills in NASA APIs, GIS mapping, Gemini AI, and web dev. Since our app is already live, you'll help elevate a working prototype! Looking for UI/UX designers, agri-experts, and storytellers to polish our demo and pitch. Join us to make the savanna bloom!
